pokedexEntries.x: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.

pokedexEntries.or: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.

pokedexEntries.y: It’s covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

pokedexEntries.as: It’s covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

pokedexEntries.su: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it’s unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

pokedexEntries.us: It uses its horns to check out its surroundings. They’re very sensitive, so if you grab them, it will feel a strong shock and be unable to move.

pokedexEntries.um: Its body is mostly water. If it dries out, it will die, so it’s always sitting with perfect stillness in the shade.

pokedexEntries.sw: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It’s considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sh: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they’ve survived.

pokedexEntries.la: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it’s nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
